pattern.en: I always drink coffee in the morning.

text.ru: Как? — наречие: прилагательное + -ly: quick → quickly, easy → easily. Особые: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard. Как часто? — always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never: перед основным глаголом (I always work), но после be (She is always late) и после вспомогательного (I have never been).
text.en: How? — adjective + -ly: quickly, easily. Special: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard. How often? — always, usually, often, sometimes, never: before the main verb, after be and auxiliaries.
text.es: Adjetivo + -ly. good → well. Frecuencia: delante del verbo, detrás de be.

rule.formula: прилагательное + -ly · always / usually / often / sometimes / never + глагол (но после be)

examples.es: Siempre bebo café por la mañana.

exercises.ru: Я никогда не ем мясо. Я вегетарианец.

exercises.en: We usually have lunch at one.

prompt.ru: Напишите, что вы делаете всегда, иногда и никогда.
prompt.en: Write what you always, sometimes and never do.
prompt.es: Escribe qué haces siempre, a veces y nunca.

exercises.template: I always … I sometimes … I never …
exercises.sample: I always walk to work. I sometimes cook. I never watch TV.
